title: probe_url: no test for malformed unclosed-bracket IPv6 input
description: `probe_url` has a `\!ip.starts_with('[')` guard that correctly prevents double-bracketing for pre-bracketed inputs. The guard also handles malformed unclosed-bracket inputs like `"[fd7a::1"` (starts with `[` but has no closing `]`): `ip.contains(':')` is true but `ip.starts_with('[')` is also true, so the else branch fires and the result is `"https://[fd7a::1:4430/.well-known/jmap"` — a bad URL that the HTTP client rejects gracefully returning `None` from `probe_peer`. This behavior is correct but untested. A test for `probe_url("[fd7a::1", 4430)` would lock in the expected output and prevent a future refactor from accidentally producing double-bracketing or panicking on this input.
